title: Isolated judge output (FROZEN Phase 0 contract)
description: Strict JSON from the single isolated judge (qwen3.8-27b). Input: the frozen note, all writes from the same session in order, source snippet, rule_flags and risk_score; never raw transcripts. Parse error, extra keys, invalid enum or timeout: judge_status=failed, judge_failed is appended to rule_flags and audit_events, NEEDS_REVIEW escalates to FAIL_CLOSED (risk_score floor 85), BLOCKED stays BLOCKED. The judge never changes a verdict or risk_score; recommended_action=purge with risk_level high|critical adds +15 to the review sort key only. No numeric confidence.
